active_problem: NFL Passing Yards Page 2 is data-correct but visually too tall and text-heavy on tablet/mobile: hit rates form a vertical wall, QB form versus defense is raw text, market timestamps expose ISO strings, single-game matchup history is oversized, environment/availability consume too much height, risks lack severity hierarchy, duplicate universal TOP controls appear, and a 50% probability / +0.2 yard edge can visually present as an OVER recommendation even though the evidence says there is no strong side.
solution: Add a presentation-only Page 2 V3 successor over the same verified Kyre Sports API payload. Compact recent hit rates into one horizontal strip with progress bars, add visual passing-yard bars to the game log, render QB form and opponent defense as metric tiles, compact single-game matchup history, humanize market freshness, compact environment and availability states, add evidence chips and risk severity, suppress the duplicate native TOP control while retaining the site-wide shell control, and classify weak CHECK-grade near-50% / negligible-edge cases as PASS while preserving genuinely actionable verified directional decisions.

decision_display_contract.weak_case: PASS when directional probability is below 55%, absolute edge is below 3.0 yards, or verified strength is CHECK/PASS/LOW/WEAK
decision_display_contract.strong_case: Preserve verified OVER/UNDER display when probability, edge, and strength clear the presentation actionability guard

tdd.red: 9/9 V3 acceptance tests failed on the frozen baseline because the V3 successor did not exist and the V2 page retained the uncompressed presentation/decision behavior.
tdd.green: 9/9 V3 acceptance tests passed after the presentation-only successor and Page 2 handoff were implemented.
